statements.statement: Collection clearing is asynchronous: clearSetOfBuckets increments the era and records collection UUIDs.
statements.note: Documented in bucket_state_registry.h and implemented in bucket_state_registry.cpp under clearSetOfBuckets.

statements.statement: Later state materialization checks clear records newer than a bucket’s lastChecked era and marks matching buckets cleared; unaffected buckets advance their lastChecked era.
statements.note: isMemberOfClearedSet checks clearedSets.lower_bound(bucket->lastChecked + 1) and advances bucket->lastChecked to currentEra when unaffected.

edits.rationale: Collection clearing in BucketCatalog is asynchronous. When clearSetOfBuckets is invoked, the catalog era is incremented and collection UUIDs are recorded in clearedSets. During later bucket state materialization (via isMemberOfClearedSet), clear records newer than bucket->lastChecked are evaluated to mark matching buckets cleared, while unaffected buckets advance bucket->lastChecked to currentEra.

edits.rationale: Direct writes synchronize through registry counters. edits.old: bucketsPerEra controls reclamation of clear history: when an era loses its last bucket, cleanup drops clear records at or before the oldest remaining bucket era, or all records when no bucket eras remain. An old bucket can therefore retain clear-history bookkeeping. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24)
edits.new: bucketsPerEra maps each era to the count of buckets associated with it. When an era's count reaches zero it is erased and the clear registry is cleaned: all cleared sets are dropped if no eras remain, otherwise cleared sets with era at or before the smallest remaining bucket era are dropped. An old bucket therefore keeps clear-history records for later eras from being reclaimed. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/bucket_catalog/bucket_state_registry.cpp

statements.statement: When an era loses its last bucket, cleanup drops clear records at or before the oldest remaining bucket era, or all records when no bucket eras remain.
statements.note: decrementEraCountHelper erases the era at count 1 and calls cleanClearRegistry, which uses upper_bound on the smallest era (so records at or before it are erased) or erases everything when the map is empty.

statements.statement: An old bucket can therefore retain clear-history bookkeeping.
statements.note: An old bucket keeps its era in bucketsPerEra, which holds the smallest era down. Records at or before that era are still dropped, so only records after it are retained. This is inferred from the code and is not stated explicitly.

queries: mongodb timeseries bucket state registry era clearedSets retained old bucket
mongodb timeseries bucket state registry era clearedSets retained old bucket

edits.rationale: bucket_state_registry.cpp implements the cleanup as described. The code erases the era entry when its count is 1 and then calls cleanClearRegistry, which erases cleared sets up to upper_bound(smallestEra), or all of them when the map is empty. The wording that bucketsPerEra 'controls' reclamation is loose, so the text is rephrased to match the code. The last sentence is also adjusted: records at or before the oldest era are dropped, so what an old bucket retains is the records after its era.
